mintAuthority.summary: AUDD is issued by AUDC Pty Ltd (AFSL 700123), with issuer-controlled multichain minting against AUD reserves held on bare trust for holders. The PDS permits Australian or foreign bank cash and AUD-denominated cash equivalents; the August 2026 AUP records cash at Westpac and Banking Circle. Ethereum's ProxyAdmin owner is now a 3-of-5 Safe. Stellar and XRPL issuer signing use 3-of-7 multisigs; XRPL's disabled master key does not lock issuance while its SignerList remains active. Solana mint authority is a 2-of-3 SPL Token multisig; Hedera token keys reference its issuer contract, not a standalone private key.

controls.label: AUDC Pty Ltd issuance backend
controls.evidence: Issuer-operated mint/redeem: AUDC Pty Ltd creates and redeems AUDD supply 1:1 against custodied AUD reserves; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists across its native multichain deployments.

controls.label: AUDD Ethereum token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295029, owner() on the AUDD ERC1967 proxy (0x4cce...0c54, impl 0xc6114a25) returned 0x59a50cbd643347296e2cf5573b40eda3099d0c54. eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA.

controls.label: AUDD Ethereum proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095936, ProxyAdmin owner() is Safe 0x0cc2ecc9b227f98c1628c1dbfb73bdfcab0623f2; threshold 3, five owners, VERSION 1.4.1, empty modules, zero guard/module-guard and standard fallback handler. Earlier review recorded EOA 0x840b18b93e44ded7d616a0f61aff8562f2548743; the current Safe observation supersedes that owner.

controls.label: AUDD Base token owner
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200702, owner() on the AUDD Base proxy (0x449b...ae65, impl 0x3c9ead9a) returned 0xa375adbc3b5497f1c3eb20cbe986e115bd2b9127. eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA.

controls.label: AUDD Base proxy admin
controls.evidence: At Base block 47200702, EIP-1967 admin slot on AUDD Base proxy returned 0x0bc67421c729b8cd22a725e40d1c4f5ca3d32f9f (ProxyAdmin contract). That ProxyAdmin's owner() returned 0x31c9cf32b2e33e1a5561c1dcf3889f574f2977fa. eth_getCode returns no bytecode → EOA.

controls.label: AUDD Stellar issuer (3-of-7 multisig)
controls.evidence: Stellar Horizon confirmed: issuer account GDC7X2MX... has master key weight 0 (locked), 7 co-signers each weight 1, and low/med/high thresholds all = 3. Effective authority is a 3-of-7 multisig. Asset is AUDD issued by this account.

controls.label: AUDD XRPL issuer (3-of-7 SignerList; master disabled)
controls.evidence: At validated XRPL ledger 107355092 (hash 54A300D5307120F8541E27305788F01BC3A3C69D33A5D7A1EA5A2F9BBC8FDF75), account_info with signer_lists=true returns a SignerList with quorum 3 and seven weight-1 entries. disableMasterKey is true and RegularKey is absent, but multisigning remains active. The previous locked-account conclusion based on an incomplete account_objects read is superseded; disabling the master key does not remove this native issuance path.

controls.label: AUDD Solana mint authority (2-of-3 SPL Token multisig)
controls.evidence: Finalized Solana mint observation at slot 452225454 returns mintAuthority CnwUoCJvduyJeKYVNVV5q21JcmRHYAb74unx9Y7mYNLF. Its finalized jsonParsed account at slot 452225929 is owned by the SPL Token program, type multisig, numRequiredSigners=2 and numValidSigners=3. It is not a System Program EOA. The separately recorded freeze authority remains 6yusyKzzPDydZeGu1JCNTcXjyEJzGRjLK8xwqAK9wqFs.

controls.label: AUDD Hedera contract-controlled token keys
controls.evidence: Mirror token 0.0.8317071 returns identical admin, freeze, pause, supply and wipe protobuf keys 4205188ed1fb03. Hedera Key field 8 decodes as delegatable_contract_id, with ContractID contractNum=8317070. The mirror contract record maps 0.0.8317070 to EVM address 0x39ceba2b467fa987546000eb5d1373acf1f3a2e1. These are contract-controlled HTS keys, not a single standalone issuer private key; the wrapper's ultimate role/upgrade authority requires its own review.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01: PDS dated 10 February 2026 establishes issuer AUDC Pty Ltd and bare-trust AUD reserves, permitting Australian/foreign bank cash or AUD equivalents. William Buck August AUP covers 31 August and is signed 4 September; it reconciles cash and all eight chains but expressly provides no assurance opinion and has no independence requirement. Pinned Ethereum/Base/XDC proxies and owners match recorded identities except Ethereum ProxyAdmin owner now a 3-of-5 Safe (full modules/guard census at block 26095936), superseding old EOA 0x840b. Stellar has seven weight-1 signers and thresholds 3; XRPL ledger 107355092 has an active 3-of-7 SignerList despite disabled master, superseding prior account-locked inference. Solana mint authority is a 2-of-3 SPL multisig, not an EOA. Hedera keys decode to contract 0.0.8317070. Redbelly owner/implementation/admin were directly queried at block 3209863. Uncapped issuer mint authority and non-prudential AFSL conduct authorization remain adverse limitations.
